intro: Let's go on an adventure for those who have lost their kanji!
description:
"Adventure of Kanjiro" is a game of kanji learning, so that children who are not good at kanji or dislike practicing kanji can learn kanji while having fun.

As Kanjiro, the main character of this work, you will discover kanji stolen by monsters by writing kanji, looking for kanji, and looking for reading. By discovering kanji, you can raise your level and earn coins.
You can use coins to buy items such as equipment and potions at the shop to prepare to fight monsters.
In battles with monsters, the faster you remember the kanji you find, the more damage you can do. However, if you remember incorrectly, you will be damaged instead.
In order to defeat monsters, it is important not only to have good items, but also to remember the kanji well.

Let's enjoy the game and memorize the kanji so that we can defeat all the monsters and get back the kanji!
